skill.name: three
skill.description: Three.js and WebGL adapter patterns for HyperFrames deterministic rendering, including hf-seek timing, fixed canvas output, AnimationMixer seeking, and safe render workflows.
skill.summary: Build deterministic Three.js and WebGL scenes for HyperFrames renders.

security_audit.summary: The skill is a concise Markdown guide for deterministic Three.js rendering inside HyperFrames. Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, documentation links, and prose; the confirmed items are a CDN module import and unpinned npx validation commands. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or suspicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The example imports Three.js from a public CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a local package import, or document trust and availability requirements for CDN use.

remediation.issue: The validation commands use npx without a package version pin.
remediation.suggestion: Document local installation, or pin the HyperFrames package version before running lint and validate.

content.value_statement: WebGL scenes can drift when animation depends on wall-clock time. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code repeatable Three.js patterns for HyperFrames renders.
actual_capabilities: Explains the HyperFrames three adapter time contract.
Shows an hf-seek render pattern for a WebGL canvas layer.
Shows fixed canvas size and pixel ratio settings for reproducible video.
Lists unsafe render patterns such as wall-clock animation and seek-time remote loading.
limitations: It is guidance, not a bundled Three.js runtime or asset pipeline.
It does not verify external CDN availability or package integrity.
It assumes assets can be loaded before frame-critical seeking.
It does not cover every WebGL post-processing pipeline.

output_examples.input: A WebGL layer changes across machines.

best_practices: Load local models, textures, and HDRIs before render-critical seeking begins.
Render from HyperFrames seek time instead of browser clock or animation loop state.
Pin canvas size and pixel ratio for video outputs.
anti_patterns: Using Date.now, performance.now, or clock deltas for render-critical motion.
Fetching remote models or textures during seek handling.
Relying on frame history when the current frame cannot be reconstructed from time.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a complete renderer?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and review guidance. The project still supplies scene assets, rendering code, and HyperFrames integration.

faq.question: Can it use remote Three.js assets?
faq.answer: It recommends local assets for render-critical work. Remote references should be moved out of seek-time rendering.

faq.question: Why avoid requestAnimationFrame?
faq.answer: HyperFrames renders exact times. Free-running loops can make frame output depend on wall-clock timing.

faq.question: How does hf-seek affect rendering?
faq.answer: The composition listens for hf-seek and renders the frame for the time in the event detail.

faq.question: Does it support AnimationMixer?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows seeking mixers directly with HyperFrames time so authored clips render deterministically.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows that edit or review HyperFrames Three.js compositions.
